content: 1. Navigate to the upload page to begin the process of uploading a picture. 2. Always rename the file to ensure the filename accurately reflects the content of the image. Uploading an Image from Radiopaedia: 3. If the image originates from Radiopaedia, use the provided example to complete the image summary section on the upload page. 4. Similarly, if the image is sourced from Radiopaedia, follow the example provided to correctly cite the image. Citing a Website: 5. To properly cite a webpage, use the following format: Title of the page. Website title (date). Available at: URL. Accessed on: Month Day, Year. Citing a Peer-Reviewed Article: 6. Search for the PMID or DOI of the article on PubMed. Once located, use the citation creator tool to generate the citation. Citing a Reference Without a PubMed ID or DOI: 7. If the reference is not available on PubMed, use the AMA referencing style as outlined in the examples below: Authors (Last Name First Initial). Title. Journal abbreviation (in italics). Year; Volume(Issue): Pages. Examples for Different Scenarios: Journal Article (1-6 authors): Hu P, Reuben DB. Effects of managed care on the length of time that elderly patients spend with physicians during ambulatory visits. Med Care. 2002;40(7):606-613. Journal Article (>6 authors): Geller AC, Venna S, Prout M, et al. Should the skin cancer examination be taught in medical school? Arch Dermatol. 2002;138(9):1201-1203. Journal Article with No Named Author or Group Name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Licensure of a meningococcal conjugate vaccine (Menveo) and guidance for use—Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP), 2010. MMWR Morb Mortal Wkly Rep. 2010;59(9):273. Electronic Journal Article: Gage BF, Fihn SD, White RH. Management and dosing of warfarin therapy. The American Journal of Medicine. 2000;109(6):481-488. doi:10.1016/S0002-9343(00)00545-3. Creating and Formatting Tables: 8. To create a table quickly, use the wiki generator tool. 9. Once the table is created, ensure it adheres to the formatting rules provided in the example. Using Category Tags: 10. Every page must include a designated category tag at the bottom. 11. Only use the approved category tags listed. 12. It is preferred to use a single category tag, but more than one may be included if necessary.
